Class Notification

java.lang.Object
com.owltask.alerting.entity.Notification
@Entity public class Notification extends Object
JPA entity for the notification table (UC-17..19, and the live alert stream). A notification is delivered to one recipient (userdestination) and may reference the project and/or task that triggered it.
